title: The generative paradox: the Anti-Prompt paradigm for human capability
abstract: arXiv:2610.40151v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI in education is usually judged by the output of human-AI teams. That focus overlooks a second outcome: what people can still understand, challenge, repair, and adapt when assistance changes or disappears. We call this tension the generative paradox and distinguish four manifestations: performance, assistance, ownership, and capability stock. We propose developmental function allocation, which complements operational function allocation and meaningful human control by treating retained human capability as a design objective alongside current joint performance. The Anti-Prompt paradigm reverses the default interaction order: when immediate generation would preempt a consequential human act, AI should first create the conditions for human construction. translated_title: 生成悖论：面向人类能力的反提示范式
translated_abstract: 教育中的生成式AI通常以人机团队的输出成果来评判。这种关注忽视了一个次要结果：当辅助发生变化或消失时，人们还能理解、质疑、修复和适应什么。我们将这种张力称为生成悖论，并区分了四种表现形式：性能、辅助、所有权和能力存量。我们提出发展性功能分配，它补充了操作性功能分配和有意义的人类控制，将保留的人类能力作为设计目标，与当前的联合性能并列。反提示范式逆转了默认的交互顺序：当即时生成会抢先取代一个重要的人类行为时，AI应首先为人类建构创造条件。我们区分了产品的有效性、其建构的责任归属以及支持变化后的能力证据。代表性的反提示、一个经典的交互……
tldr: 本文提出“生成悖论”概念与“反提示范式”，主张当即时生成会取代重要的人类行为时，AI应优先为人类建构创造条件，并将保留人类能力作为与当前联合性能并列的设计目标。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the "generative paradox" and the Anti-Prompt paradigm, arguing that when immediate AI generation would preempt a consequential human act, AI should first create conditions for human construction, treating retained human capability as a design objective alongside current joint performance.
